name: Jev fast decisions
description: Answers COGNIX[WS]'s fast decisions with TypeSafe's Jev: which element of a page matches what an agent described, and yes/no questions about a page. Sends the page's text (and, to locate on screen, a screenshot) to api.typesafe.ai.

settings.label: TypeSafe API key
settings.description: From console.typesafe.ai/keys. It stays in this extension's encrypted settings.

settings.label: Model
settings.description: jev-latest is the stable release; jev-preview is the newest, and the only one that locates things in screenshots.
